about_the_game: Immerse yourself in the horrors of a cursed village where La Llorona roams. In this 4v1 asymmetrical multiplayer horror experience, four players take on the role of survivors performing ancient rituals to survive, while one becomes the vengeful ghost. Use strategy, teamwork, and spiritual tools to banish the spirit or escape her wrath. Inspired by Latin American legends, this game combines intense tension, dynamic gameplay, and supernatural powers in an unforgettable haunting.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains intense horror themes and violent content that may not be suitable for all audiences. Players can experience graphic scenes such as drowning, ritual killings, and exorcisms performed on the demonic entity known as La Llorona. These elements, combined with the dark supernatural atmosphere, may be considered disturbing or mature content by many players. Viewer discretion is advised.

short_description: Trapped in a cursed land haunted by a weeping spirit, four Survivors must perform rituals or escape before La Llorona finds them. One player becomes the ghost, hunting the rest using supernatural powers in this asymmetrical multiplayer horror rooted in Latin American legend.
